messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate in prod (us-west-2). Started ~2026-03-15T18:42:10Z. Aggregate error rate ~11.8% (baseline ~0.2%). Initial logs point to prefix-cache misses, eviction bursts, and checksum mismatches in KV lookups. Incident ID INC-5921. Please acknowledge.

alex.chen: acking, I'm the current oncall and will take lead.

maya.patel: I'm caught in a meeting, handing to Alex. FYI we applied a prefix-cache tuning earlier today (ttl=30s, eviction_threshold lowered).

samir: backup oncall here. standing by.

olivia: dumping a few recent log snippets: 
```text
[18:42:14] prefix_index lookup shard=pi-12 key="u:123:ctx" err=checksum_mismatch
[18:42:15] eviction_event shard=pi-12 rate=420/s freed=240
[18:42:16] http 502 /v1/generate id=xyz upstream=kv timeout=1200ms
```

priya.k: any config rollouts around 18:40? ci-bot shows configs/prefix-cache/eviction-threshold changed at 18:40:03.

deploy-bot: rollout config: configs/prefix-cache/eviction-threshold -> 0.6 applied at 18:40:03 in us-west-2.

alex.chen: makes sense. hypothesis: lowering threshold + short TTL triggered an eviction storm, causing high churn and some index corruption or inconsistent reads. Immediate mitigation: set per-route prefix cache bypass for /v1/generate so those requests hit KV directly.

samir: can we flip that quickly?

alex.chen: executing: 
```bash
redwoodctl feature-flags set --route "/v1/generate" --flag prefix_cache.bypass=true --env prod --region us-west-2
```

deploy-bot: feature flag accepted and propagating.

alex.chen: CLI: flag set -> prefix_cache.bypass=true (propagation id pr-8841).

olivia: after flipping, error rate fell to ~6.3% within a minute. Improvement but still high.

customer-success: monitoring CS dashboard: 18 orgs impacted, 3 critical with >50% errors. Engaging account leads.

priya.k: suggestion: route a fraction of traffic to a variant that doesn't consult the prefix cache to reduce load on corrupted indices.

alex.chen: updating routing: 
```bash
redwoodctl route update --route "/v1/generate" --traffic "fallback=25%,primary=75%" --env prod --region us-west-2
```

deploy-bot: routing change accepted.

maya.patel: I'll take oncall at 19:00 UTC; Alex please prepare a short handoff with actions and SLO impact.

alex.chen: handoff notes: 
- Actions taken: set prefix_cache.bypass=true for /v1/generate; routed 25% to fallback variant.
- Observed: checksum_mismatch errors and eviction spikes on several shards, particularly pi-12.
- Root cause hypothesis: aggressive eviction threshold change combined with low TTL leading to eviction storm and index inconsistencies.
- Customer impact: 18 orgs affected; 3 with major failures.
- Mitigations in progress: bypass, routing split, rollback of eviction_threshold, background index rebuild for impacted shards.
- Current metrics: error rate dropped from 11.8% -> 4.6%. Monitoring for stability.

maya.patel: ack. If >5% persists for 10m escalate to infra-eng and consider rolling restarts for prefix-cache processes.

samir: prepared restart command if needed: 
```bash
infractl rollout restart --service prefix-cache --shards pi-10..pi-14 --grace 45s --parallel 2
```

olivia: checking rollback feasibility. Alex, queueing rollback now.

alex.chen: rollback command: 
```bash
redwoodctl config rollback --path configs/prefix-cache/eviction-threshold --env prod --region us-west-2 --to-revision 112
```

deploy-bot: rollback queued; expected to apply in ~120s.

priya.k: drafting customer note: "Preliminary: a prefix-cache config change triggered an eviction spike and caused prefix index inconsistencies leading to KV lookup failures and increased 5xx. We bypassed the prefix cache for the generation route and rolled back the config. Monitoring ongoing; we'll follow up with a postmortem."

customer-success: sending immediate notification to impacted customers now.

alex.chen: quick health snapshot: 
```text
t=18:40 err=0.2%
t=18:42 err=11.8%
t=18:44 err=6.3% (after bypass)
t=18:48 err=4.6% (after rollback start)
```

maya.patel: tagging infra oncall @jose for system-level checks. Jose, can you watch host metrics and run kv-tool health on suspected shards?

jose: infra oncall here. Running checks; Olivia please run kv-tool for pi-12.

olivia: running: 
```text
kv-tool health --shard pi-12
status: degraded
checksum_mismatch: 31
eviction_rate: 410/s
mem_usage: 85%
open_files: 2174
```

samir: checksum mismatches that high look like partial index corruption. Plan: mark affected prefixes as degraded and kick off background rebuilds. Keep bypass active until rebuilds complete.

alex.chen: starting rebuild job: 
```bash
kv-maintain rebuild-prefix-index --shard pi-12 --background --throttle 150/s
```

deploy-bot: rebuild job started pid=1179.

olivia: rebuild progress 35% and no new checksum errors in rebuilt segments so far.

maya.patel: operational plan: keep bypass until rebuild completes and error rate stabilizes below 1% for 15m. If rebuild exceeds 2 hours, schedule rolling restarts and full consistency repair. Next handoff: maya -> samir at 21:00 UTC.

priya.k: action items post-incident: add canary gating to eviction-threshold config changes, add an automated validation that alerts if ttl < 2*eviction_window, and create a playbook for prefix-index rebuild scenarios.

customer-success: provisional update sent; awaiting responses from affected accounts.

alex.chen: adding runbook link to the incident ticket: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-index-repair

maya.patel: I'll set the incident status to mitigating and close the active page. Updating INC-5921 with timeline and actions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-5921 status updated to "mitigating" by maya.patel.
